apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Adds measured generated and total displayed FPS beside decoded stream FPS. Checks interpolation axis/pixel-count limits before processing, preventing a reproduced oversized/unwritten output path that can cause invalid/green frames. MetalFX presets and resolution labels respect FG size limits; start a fresh session after selecting an eligible size. Codec/HDR/color/FPS retained. Device retest needed. Unsigned build, 182 tests and combined SDR/PQ interpolation+MetalFX GPU checks passed; one simulator skip.
